artifacts.summary: Implementation summary covering the three-way classification rewrite, partial-branch consolidation, the regression suite, and the direct parity demonstration

completion_data.completion_summary: Rewrote handoff_permits_promotion() in reconcile-task-status.sh with a three-way classification (exact match permits; on-enum terminal mismatch refuses unchanged; off-vocabulary/empty/unparseable/in_progress permits with a mandatory diagnostic), consolidated the partial branch's inline duplicate onto the shared helper, and added an 11-case, 14-assertion fixture-driven regression suite proven non-vacuous by reverting the fix in a scratch copy.

memory_candidates.content: Test suites regression-guarding a JUST-EDITED source-store script (agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/**) must resolve the script under test SOURCE-STORE-FIRST, not deploy-tree-first. .claude/scripts/ is a gitignored mirror refreshed only on explicit redeploy, so a deploy-tree-first candidate order (the idiom used by tests guarding STABLE, already-deployed shared libraries like phase-heading-patterns.sh) silently validates stale pre-fix code whenever the deployed copy lags the source-store edit. Symptom: a freshly-written regression suite fails most of its new cases on first run, with a stack trace/output that matches the OLD code's behavior rather than the new. Fix: swap SCRIPTS_SRC_CANDIDATES order to prefer agent-system/extensions/core/scripts before .claude/scripts, and document why in the test's header comment so a future reader doesn't 'fix' it back.

memory_candidates_harvested.disposition: reviewed; folded into consolidated cross-task memories
